title: Runbook: Console guided onboarding checklist — feature flag rollout & telemetry health
author: Dylan Brooks
related_pages: ADR-0137 Onboarding checklist state and validation
content:
## Purpose
This runbook describes how to enable/disable the Console guided onboarding checklist behind a feature flag, how to monitor onboarding telemetry health during rollout, and how to roll back safely.

This runbook is intended for Console/platform engineers and SRE on-call supporting the rollout of the Hosted API onboarding checklist (Phase 1).

## Scope
In scope:
- Feature flag operations (cohort targeting, allowlists, percent rollouts)
- Telemetry health monitoring (ingestion → pipeline → warehouse availability)
- Rollback procedures (UI disable, event emission disable, and state model safeguards)

Out of scope:
- Dedicated/Private onboarding (follow-on initiative)
- Deep SSO/SAML onboarding flows

## Owners / escalation
- Primary owner (Console): Dylan Brooks
- Backend/state model: Chloe Martin
- Telemetry platform: Logan Wright
- Event schema + pipelines: Nadia Rahman
- Product rollout/decision: Marissa Cole

Escalation guidance:
- If telemetry ingestion/pipeline is broken or privacy constraints are violated: page Telemetry on-call and Security on-call immediately.
- If checklist UI causes Console-wide performance regressions or elevated error rates: page Console on-call (Platform) and initiate rollback.

## Definitions
- “Checklist”: the in-Console guided onboarding checklist for Hosted API onboarding steps.
- “Cohort”: the set of orgs/projects for which the checklist is visible.
- “Telemetry health”: the ability to emit, ingest, process, and query onboarding events with acceptable latency and completeness.

## Systems / components
- Redwood Console (frontend)
- Console backend (checklist state API)
- Feature flag service: Flagger
- Telemetry emission libraries:
  - console-web telemetry client
  - console-api telemetry emitter
- Telemetry pipeline:
  - telemetry-ingest
  - events-kafka (topic: telemetry.onboarding)
  - stream processor: telemetry-normalizer
  - warehouse tables: analytics.onboarding_events_v1
- Dashboards:
  - “Onboarding funnel (checklist)”
  - “Telemetry health — onboarding events”
  - “Console web vitals & errors”

## Feature flags
### Primary flag
- Flag key: `console.guided_onboarding_checklist`
- Purpose: controls visibility of checklist UI and step deep-links.

### Supporting flags (if configured)
These may be used to isolate failure modes during rollout. If present, prefer disabling the narrowest flag first.
- `console.guided_onboarding_checklist.telemetry_emit` — disables onboarding event emission from Console web (UI may still render).
- `console.guided_onboarding_checklist.backend_state` — disables server-side checklist state reads/writes (UI falls back to local/placeholder state).
- `console.guided_onboarding_checklist.validation_signals` — disables automated validators (e.g., first successful request) to reduce backend load.

Note: Not all environments have all supporting flags. Validate in Flagger before relying on them.

## Prerequisites before enabling in any environment
1) Confirm release build/version
- Console web release includes checklist shell and routing behind `console.guided_onboarding_checklist`.
- Console backend includes checklist state endpoints and permissions checks.

2) Confirm privacy posture
- Telemetry properties must be allowlisted per “Onboarding telemetry event schema v1”.
- No customer prompt content, no raw request/response bodies.
- Verify retention tags applied as reviewed in “Privacy review: Onboarding telemetry”.

3) Confirm dashboards are live
- “Telemetry health — onboarding events” dashboard must show the last 24h for the current environment.
- Ensure alert policies are enabled (see Telemetry health SLOs & alerts below).

4) Confirm support readiness (beta/GA)
- Support macros reference troubleshooting doc for common onboarding failures (401/429/streaming disconnect/CORS).
- Admin override/reset procedure is documented and access controlled.

## Rollout strategy (recommended)
### Environments
- Dev/staging: 100% enabled for internal dogfood
- Production:
  1) Allowlist: internal orgs only (Redwood employees)
  2) Small % of new orgs (e.g., 1%)
  3) Increase percent for new orgs (5% → 10% → 25% → 50%)
  4) Expand to all new orgs
  5) Optional: backfill cohort to include existing orgs (requires PM approval due to funnel skew)

### Targeting rules (best practice)
- Target by org creation date when possible (minimizes confusion for existing users and reduces analytics skew).
- Keep an explicit allowlist for:
  - Pilot/beta design partners
  - Support troubleshooting orgs
  - Internal QA orgs

### Change management
- All production flag changes require:
  - Link to rollout ticket/approval (Linear) in the change description
  - Notation of previous value → new value
  - On-call owner for the next 2 hours

## Procedure: Enable checklist for an allowlisted org
1) Open Flagger → Feature flags → `console.guided_onboarding_checklist`.
2) Add org ID to allowlist targeting rule:
   - Rule name: `onboarding_checklist_allowlist`
   - Condition: `org_id IN [ ... ]`
3) Set treatment: `on`.
4) Save and propagate.
5) Validate within 5 minutes:
   - Log in as a user in the org.
   - Confirm checklist card/entry point renders.
   - Confirm step deep-links open expected docs pages.
   - Confirm at least one onboarding telemetry event appears in the “Telemetry health — onboarding events” dashboard (see “Telemetry validation” below).

## Procedure: Percent rollout to new orgs
1) Confirm there is a targeting rule keyed off `org_created_at` (or `org_is_new` if available) to avoid affecting existing orgs.
2) In Flagger, set percent rollout for the “new orgs” rule:
   - Start at 1%.
3) Save and propagate.
4) Monitor for 60 minutes before increasing:
   - Console error rate, latency
   - Telemetry event ingestion health
   - Checklist API error rate (if backend state enabled)
5) Increase gradually (5% → 10% → 25% → 50%).
6) Document each increase in the rollout ticket, including dashboard screenshots or links.

## Procedure: Disable checklist (soft rollback)
Use this when the checklist experience is problematic but Console is otherwise healthy.

1) Set `console.guided_onboarding_checklist` to `off` for the affected cohort(s):
   - Prefer: set percent rollout to 0% and/or remove allowlist entries.
2) Confirm UI is hidden:
   - Re-load Console and confirm checklist entry point is not visible.
3) Continue monitoring:
   - If telemetry is the issue, also consider disabling telemetry emission (see “Disable telemetry emission”).

## Procedure: Disable telemetry emission (telemetry rollback)
Use this if telemetry is causing privacy risk, pipeline overload, or cascading failures.

Preferred (if flag exists):
1) Set `console.guided_onboarding_checklist.telemetry_emit` to `off`.
2) Leave UI flag as-is only if PM approves (users may still see checklist, but funnel tracking will be incomplete).

If no dedicated telemetry flag exists:
1) Disable the primary checklist flag (`console.guided_onboarding_checklist` → off) to stop event emission tied to checklist flows.
2) Page Telemetry on-call to assess whether additional rate limiting or sampling changes are required.

## Telemetry health SLOs & alerts
### Service level objectives (rollout gate)
During beta/GA rollout, treat these as launch gates:
- Ingestion completeness: ≥ 99% of onboarding events accepted by telemetry-ingest (HTTP 2xx) over 15-minute windows.
- Pipeline latency: p95 < 5 minutes from emit time → availability in `analytics.onboarding_events_v1`.
- Schema validity: ≥ 99.5% of events pass allowlist validation (no dropped properties beyond expected redaction).

### Alert conditions (recommended thresholds)
- Missing events by region: onboarding event count drops > 50% vs 7-day baseline for any region for 10 minutes.
- Pipeline delay: p95 pipeline latency > 15 minutes for 15 minutes.
- Event rejection spike: allowlist/schema rejection rate > 1% for 10 minutes.

If an alert triggers during rollout:
1) Freeze rollout (do not increase cohort).
2) Determine severity:
   - Privacy breach risk → disable telemetry emission immediately + page Security.
   - Pipeline delay only → freeze rollout + page Telemetry.
   - Console errors → disable checklist UI + page Console on-call.

## Telemetry validation checklist (manual spot-check)
Use this after each cohort change.

1) Confirm events are being emitted
- In browser devtools (Console), confirm telemetry POSTs return 2xx.
- Confirm request payload does not include:
  - prompts
  - completions
  - raw headers beyond allowlisted identifiers

2) Confirm events are ingested
- Check telemetry-ingest metrics:
  - `requests_total{source="console-web", stream="onboarding"}`
  - `requests_2xx_rate`

3) Confirm warehouse availability
- Query (example):
  - Table: `analytics.onboarding_events_v1`
  - Filter: `event_name like 'onboarding_%' and received_at > now() - interval '30 minutes'`

4) Confirm dedupe/idempotency
- For step completion events, verify `dedupe_key` is stable and not producing repeated “completed” spikes for a single org/project.

## Rollback decision tree
### A) Console instability (elevated 5xx, client errors, or perf regressions)
Action:
1) Disable `console.guided_onboarding_checklist` immediately for all cohorts.
2) If errors persist, investigate unrelated deploys; checklist may not be the root cause.

### B) Checklist backend/state API issues (4xx/5xx on checklist endpoints)
Action:
1) If supporting flag exists: disable `console.guided_onboarding_checklist.backend_state` or `validation_signals` first.
2) Otherwise: disable primary checklist flag.
3) Open incident if error budget impact is material.

### C) Telemetry pipeline issues (missing/late events)
Action:
1) Freeze rollout.
2) If privacy-safe: keep UI on, but consider turning off telemetry emission if pipeline overload is causing cascading failures.
3) If issue is isolated to a region, consider region-scoped disable (if targeting supports it) to reduce blast radius.

### D) Privacy or schema violation
Action (highest priority):
1) Disable telemetry emission immediately.
2) Disable primary checklist flag.
3) Page Security + Telemetry on-call.
4) Start an incident and preserve evidence:
   - sample event payload (redacted)
   - exact flag state and timestamp
   - affected org IDs (restricted distribution)

## Post-rollback steps
1) Confirm user impact is mitigated
- Checklist UI not visible (or telemetry not emitted).
- Console core functionality stable.

2) Annotate dashboards
- Add an annotation for rollback time to telemetry and console health dashboards.

3) File follow-ups
- Create/attach bugs with:
  - cohort/flag state
  - time window
  - region(s)
  - representative request IDs (telemetry-safe)

4) Communicate
- #eng-releases: what changed, why, next steps
- #support (if user-visible): a short summary and whether to expect inbound questions

## Common failure modes & mitigations
1) “Checklist shows but steps never complete”
- Likely validator lag or missing backend signals.
- Mitigation: disable `validation_signals` (if available) or instruct users to proceed with manual steps; confirm validators’ source metrics are healthy.

2) “Telemetry events missing from one region”
- Likely regional pipeline/collector issue.
- Mitigation: freeze rollout, reduce cohort in affected region, page Telemetry on-call.

3) “Spike in 401s during onboarding”
- Often due to using a test key in a prod environment (or wrong key copied).
- Mitigation: ensure prod vs test key UX is enabled; link checklist step to API key docs; Support can use macro referencing 401 troubleshooting.

4) “Spike in 429s after enabling checklist”
- Could be more users reaching first-request quickly, hitting default quotas.
- Mitigation: verify rate limit/quota education step links correctly; ensure docs clarify 429 handling and how quotas are applied.

## Operational notes
- Do not use checklist telemetry to capture or infer customer prompt content.
- Avoid enabling the checklist for large existing orgs without PM approval; it can distort onboarding metrics and create confusion for established workflows.
- When troubleshooting a specific org, prefer allowlist targeting over global percent changes.

## Quick reference
- Primary flag: `console.guided_onboarding_checklist`
- Rollback (fastest): set primary flag to OFF globally
- Telemetry emergency: disable telemetry emission (supporting flag if present) + page Security + Telemetry
- Rollout gate: pipeline p95 latency < 5 min; ingestion completeness ≥ 99%
